goldens.comment: The @loaded_locales instance variable in translate_accelerator.rb is lazily initialized and accessed by multiple concurrent threads without synchronization.

Consider normalizing the input locale (e.g., to a symbol) when checking/loading here to avoid double-loading if the same locale is passed as a String vs Symbol (also applies to other locations in the PR).

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:16 — SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym` raises NoMethodError on nil/blank default_locale, and since `FallbackLocaleList#[]` is invoked by `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks#translate` on every `I18n.t` call, this would break all translations app-wide

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym` in `FallbackLocaleList#[]` (config/initializers/i18n.rb:16). If `SiteSetting.default_locale` were ever `nil`, this would raise `NoMethodError` and could impact translation lookups, since `I18n.fallbacks[locale]` is used by fallbacks logic. However, the diff does not show whether `SiteSetting.default_locale` can actually be nil in this app (it’s used elsewhere as a default), so this is a plausible edge-case concern rather than a verifiable defect from the diff alone. Also, the finding’s mention of “blank” is overstated: `"".to_sym` does not raise; only `nil` would.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/controllers/application_controller.rb:159 — set_locale now runs I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! on every request, allocating a small array and doing up to 3 O(n) linear scans of @loaded_locales (n bounded by supported-locale count, so cost is negligible in practice, not a real regression)

adjudication.rationale: The diff does add `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` inside `ApplicationController#set_locale`, so it will run on every request. `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!` iterates over up to three locales (`[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en]`), and each calls `I18n.ensure_loaded!(l)`. The added `TranslateAccelerator#ensure_loaded!` uses `@loaded_locales.include?(locale)` where `@loaded_locales` is an Array, so each call is an O(n) linear scan and the fallback list allocation happens per request. This is a concrete, diff-grounded (minor) perf/overhead concern, not a correctness bug.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/controllers/application_controller.rb:159 — I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is invoked unguarded (no begin/rescue) inside the `set_locale` before_filter that runs on every single request, so any exception raised while loading locale files will bubble up and break every request for the process, not just the one that triggered it.

adjudication.rationale: The diff does add an unguarded `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` call inside `ApplicationController#set_locale`, which runs per-request, and `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!` delegates to `I18n.ensure_loaded!(l)` without any rescue. If locale loading raises (e.g., missing/corrupt locale data), the exception will propagate and cause the current request to error. However, the finding’s claim that it will “break every request for the process” is not directly supported by the diff (an exception would typically yield a 500 for that request and the process continues, and it would only repeat for locales that keep failing to load).

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:23 — I18n.fallbacks = FallbackLocaleList.new` is set unconditionally in the initializer for all environments, whereas the removed `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` lines were previously opt-in only for production.rb, cloud66 production.rb, and profile.rb; this is a behavior change that silently enables fallback-masking of missing translations in every environment (including development/test, if present), which can hide genuine missing-translation reliability bugs that were previously surfaced.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `config/initializers/i18n.rb` which unconditionally includes `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` and sets `I18n.fallbacks = FallbackLocaleList.new` for the whole app, while it removes `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` from `config/environments/production.rb`, `config/environments/profile.rb`, and `config/cloud/cloud66/files/production.rb`. From the diff alone, this is a real cross-environment behavior change (fallbacks now configured via initializer rather than per-environment), which can plausibly mask missing-translation issues during development/test. It’s a concrete, diff-grounded review concern, but not a verifiable functional defect by itself (it may be intentional).

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:16 — No test covers SiteSetting.default_locale being nil/blank, which would raise NoMethodError on nil.to_sym or produce an unexpected :"" fallback locale.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds custom fallback logic in `config/initializers/i18n.rb` where `FallbackLocaleList#[]` unconditionally calls `SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym`. If `SiteSetting.default_locale` can ever be `nil` or blank, this would raise (`nil.to_sym`) or create an odd fallback locale (e.g., `:""`). The finding is grounded in the new code path, but the diff alone doesn’t prove `default_locale` can be nil/blank, so it’s best treated as an unhandled edge-case / missing coverage concern rather than a confirmed defect.

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:16 — No test verifies .uniq correctly dedups the fallback chain when I18n.locale == SiteSetting.default_locale, collapsing [locale, locale, :en] to [locale, :en].

adjudication.rationale: The diff does add `.uniq.compact` to the fallback chain in `FallbackLocaleList#[]`, so the dedup behavior described would already occur. The claim that "No test verifies" this case cannot be confirmed from the provided diff (no test changes are shown), so the finding asserts something not verifiable from the diff.

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:16 — No test verifies actual fallback behavior end-to-end: a translation missing in the user's locale falls back to SiteSetting.default_locale, and if also missing there falls back to :en.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces new, nontrivial fallback behavior via `FallbackLocaleList#[]` returning `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en]` and new loading logic (`FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!` plus `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` in `ApplicationController#set_locale`). No corresponding spec/test changes are shown in this diff to exercise that end-to-end fallback order, so the concern about missing coverage is specific and grounded in the change (even though the global test suite can’t be verified from the diff alone).

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/controllers/application_controller.rb:158 — No controller/request spec exercises set_locale calling I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! to confirm the correct locale files get loaded per-request.

adjudication.rationale: The diff does add a new call in `ApplicationController#set_locale` (`I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!`), but it contains no test/spec changes. From the diff alone, we cannot verify the claim that “no controller/request spec exercises” this path—such specs could already exist elsewhere in the repo.
